assertions.name: a connection cannot be started asking for a right to change the connected system
a connection to a system that does not exist is refused rather than created
a new connection has done the two steps it could not exist without, and no more
it starts in observation, with nothing observed about the system yet
a second connection to the same system resumes rather than starting beside it
an endpoint whose certificate did not verify does not complete the step, and says why
a verified endpoint completes the step and moves the wizard on
the database refuses an endpoint recorded without a verification result
something that looks like a pasted secret does not fit in the reference field
a reference containing whitespace, which a copied credential block would, is refused
a reference to a customer-held secret completes the step
there is no column on a connection in which a secret could be written
the step is not done because the connection says so; it is not done because no check exists
the step reports exactly what the recorded check observed, not what was requested
what was asked for and what was observed stay separate facts
an asset existing on the system does not approve it for the connection
an asset on another system cannot be approved into this connection
an explicitly approved asset completes the step
withdrawing the approval makes the step undone again, because it was measured rather than stored
no mapping to this system means step 7 is outstanding
a mapping binding a principal and purpose to this system completes step 7
configuring a connection does not carry the authority to enable it
the ladder cannot be skipped
a connection with an unfinished step is not enabled, and the refusal names which step
the preview ran and acted on nothing
a preview evaluated against this system completes step 8 without acting on anything
coordination is a stage somebody chose, and it is still not permission to mutate
a connection is never quietly returned to observation
approved enforcement is reached only after every other step, and completes the ninth
the database refuses enforcement for a system no check found able to restrict
a connection record is kept rather than deleted, so what was connected stays answerable
an auditor may read a connection but may not start or change one
an actor holding neither capability cannot see the connections at all
